다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분을 다음과 같이 수동태로 바꿔 쓸 때, 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 쓰시오.
Before they reach the puddles, however, many maengkkongi die on the road. They jump down to the road and try to cross it. Some get run over by cars. Those that make it to the other side cannot climb back up because the stone blocks are too high. To prevent the maengkkongi from crossing the road, humans need to build fences and small puddles near their habitat. However, no one has taken any action.
→ _____ by humans
answer: fences and small puddles need to be built
solution: 능동태인 humans(주어) + need to build(동사구) + fences and small puddles(목적어)를 수동태로 전환 시, 능동태의 목적어인 fences and small puddles가 수동태의 주어로 위치하고, 동사구 need to build는 주어(복수)에 맞춰 need to be built('~될 필요가 있다') 형태의 수동형으로 바뀐다.
source: 영어플랫 · YBM(김) 공통영어2 Project 2 실전 모의고사

body:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분이 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?
So early in the morning and at night, Paul goes out to find and help maengkkongi in danger. He usually saves around 400 maengkkongi every day. He has been doing this by himself for three years. Capturing endangered species like maengkkongi without permission from the government is illegal. So all Paul can do is move the maengkkongi from the road to the neighboring woods. Paul hopes more people will pay attention to the sad reality that puts these little frogs at risk. During a TV interview, Paul expressed concern that if nothing is done soon, the situation will repeat itself. Fortunately, the government has made a plan to examine the issue. It has stated that measures will be taken to stop maengkkongi from dying on roads. Human development has done much harm to nature. It is time for humans to take action and fix the things they have done wrong.
solution: 밑줄 친 부분에서 “take action”은 단순히 어떤 행동을 시작하라는 의미가 아니라, 인간의 개발로 인해 발생한 환경 문제에 대해 더 이상 방관하지 말고 책임 있는 조치를 취해야 한다는 의미이다. 또한 “fix the things they have done wrong”은 인간의 행동으로 인해 발생한 자연 훼손을 인정하고 이를 바로잡아야 한다는 뜻이다. 따라서 ② People should reconsider development practices and take responsibility for their consequences.가 가장 적절하다. ②는 원문의 표현을 그대로 반복하지 않고, the things they have done wrong → development practices and their consequences take action and fix → reconsider ... and take responsibility 와 같이 추상화하여 의미를 바꾸어 표현하고 있으므로, 단순한 직역보다 문맥 전체를 이해해야 답할 수 있다. ① 환경 피해를 피할 수 없는 것으로 받아들이자는 의미로, 문제를 바로잡아야 한다는 글의 주장과 반대된다. ③ 글의 일부 세부 내용인 불법 포획 문제에만 초점을 맞춘다. ④ Paul의 개인적 활동을 일반화한 것으로, 밑줄 친 문장의 핵심인 인간 전체의 환경적 책임과 다르다. ⑤ 이미 발생한 문제를 해결하려는 행동까지 부정하므로 글의 주장과 맞지 않는다. YBM(김) Project2
source: 영어플랫 · YBM(김) 공통영어2 Project 2 실전 모의고사
choices: Humans should accept environmental damage as an unavoidable consequence of progress.
People should reconsider development practices and take responsibility for their consequences.
Governments need to strengthen legal restrictions on the capture of endangered species.
Individuals should devote themselves to rescuing endangered animals regardless of legal limits.
Humans ought to leave nature alone rather than attempt to deal with existing environmental problems.

body:

solution: 빈칸 앞에서 인간의 개발이 자연에 많은 해를 끼쳤다(Human development has done much harm to nature)고 말한 뒤, 그에 대한 결론으로 인간이 행동에 나서 자신들이 저지른 잘못을 바로잡아야 한다는 내용이 이어지는 것이 가장 자연스럽다. 따라서 ⑤ It is time for humans to take action and fix the things they have done wrong. 다른 선택지는 지문의 세부 내용이나 일부 관련 내용을 바탕으로 하였지만, 글 전체의 결론으로 이어지기에는 적절하지 않다.
source: 영어플랫 · YBM(김) 공통영어2 Project 2 실전 모의고사
choices: The government alone should be responsible for protecting endangered animals.
Paul needs to rescue more frogs by continuing his work by himself.
Humans should completely stop developing land to avoid harming nature.
People should learn more about the living habits of endangered animals.
It is time for humans to take action and fix the things they have done wrong.

body:
다음 글을 읽고 물음에 답하시오.
So early in the morning and at night, Paul goes out to find and help maengkkongi in danger. He usually saves around 400 maengkkongi every day. He has been doing this by himself for three years. ⓐCapturing endangered species like maengkkongi without permission from the government is illegal. ⓑSo all Paul can do is move the maengkkongi from the road to the neighboring woods.
ⓒPaul hopes more people will pay attention to the sad reality that puts these little frogs at risk. ⓓDuring a TV interview, Paul expressed concern that if nothing is done soon, the situation will repeat itself. Fortunately, the government has made a plan to examine the issue. ⓔIt has stated what measures will be taken to stop maengkkongi from dying on roads. Human development has done much harm to nature. It is time for humans to take action and fix the things they have done wrong.

밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 문장 중, 어법상 어색한 것을 골라, 올바른 문장으로 고쳐 쓰시오.
, _____
answer: ⓔ It has stated that measures will be taken to stop maengkkongi from dying on roads.
solution: 명사절을 이끄는 what 뒤에 완전한 절(measures will be taken ~)이 오므로 what을 접속사 that으로 고쳐야 한다.
source: 영어플랫 · YBM(김) 공통영어2 Project 2 실전 모의고사

body:
다음 글을 읽고, 맹꽁이가 도로 건너편에 도달하더라도 다 시 원래 위치로 돌아오지 못하는 이유를 본문에서 찾아 우 리말로 쓰시오.
Before they reach the puddles, however, many maengkkongi die on the road. They jump down to the road and try to cross it. Some get run over by cars. Those that make it to the other side cannot climb back up because the stone blocks are too high. To prevent the maengkkongi from crossing the road, fences and small puddles need to be built near their habitat. However, no one has taken any action.
→
answer: 도로 건너편의 돌블록(경계석/석축)이 너무 높기 때문이다.
solution: 본문 네 번째 문장인 'Those that make it to the other side cannot climb back up because the stone blocks are too high.'에서 직접적인 이유를 찾을 수 있다. 맹꽁이가 차를 피해 도로 건너편까지 이동하더라도, 길가에 설치된 돌블록(석축)의 높이가 너무 높아 원래 있던 위치(서식지 방향) 로 다시 올라가거나 돌아오지 못하게 된다.
source: 영어플랫 · YBM(김) 공통영어2 Project 2 실전 모의고사
